spec.topic: How to build a web app with AI
spec.promise: Build a functional web app without coding knowledge

hook.say: No coding background needed for this app.

scenes.say: I wanted a tool to organize my client tasks without paying monthly subscriptions.
scenes.visual_hint: bold title card on brand background

scenes.say: The stack is simple. HTML and JavaScript for the front, plus a lightweight database.
scenes.visual_hint: three items appear step by step

scenes.say: Instead of asking for a full project, I asked for one feature at a time.
scenes.prompt: Build a clean HTML page with a form to submit client tasks.
scenes.visual_hint: prompt types inside an app frame

scenes.say: The tricky part was when the AI broke old features while adding new ones.

visual.prompt: a split comparison card slides in

scenes.visual_hint: comparison between broken and fixed code

scenes.say: The fix is easy. Save your working code before every single new prompt.
Now the entire tool runs cleanly right inside my browser.

visual.prompt: a rocket icon glows above a clean app window

scenes.visual_hint: rocket icon with clean app display

cta.say: Get the prompts in our Telegram Lab.
